notes:
1) Screen recording: attached in Review Information (real device flow: home, a fold game, a duel, settings).
2) Purpose and audience: Midfold is a set of short offline party games for one or two people. Made for iPhone Duo: the fold games read the hinge angle (onHingeChange) and the duels split the inner display at the fold (division reserved region), each half turned toward its player. Ages 4+.
3) How to use: no sign-in. Open a game from the home screen. Fold games: open/close an iPhone Duo (or tilt the device / use the slider on other iPhones and iPads). Duels: lay the device flat between two players and tap on your own half.
4) External services: none. No network access, no accounts, no ads, no analytics.
5) Regional differences: none.
6) Regulated content: none. No purchases.

betaDescription.en-US: Midfold: party games you play with the fold. On iPhone Duo, open and close the phone to steer Fold Flight and Angle Lock, or lay it flat and duel face to face across the fold (Quick Draw, Tug Line, Odd Spot). On other iPhones and iPads, tilt or use the slider; duels split the screen. Please tell us how the hinge controls feel and whether each duel half faces the right player.
betaDescription.tr: Midfold: katlayarak oynanan parti oyunları. iPhone Duo'da telefonu açıp kapatarak Katla Uç ve Açı Kilidi'ni oynayın ya da düz bırakıp katlama çizgisinin iki yanında karşılıklı kapışın (Hızlı Dokun, Halat Çek, Farklıyı Bul). Diğer iPhone ve iPad'lerde eğin ya da kaydırıcıyı kullanın; düellolarda ekran ikiye bölünür. Menteşe kontrolünün nasıl hissettirdiğini ve her yarının doğru oyuncuya baktığını bize yazın.

whatToTest: Hinge-controlled Fold Flight and Angle Lock on iPhone Duo (half open), and the three duels with the phone open flat between two players.
